You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    for a in group_rows:
        # last shape cell on this row
        sh=[j for j in range(W) if inp[a][j]==sc]
        lb=max(sh)
        filled=[j for j in range(lb+1,W) if out[a][j]==1]
        unfilled=[j for j in range(lb+1,W) if inp[a][j]==bg]
        print('row',a,'lastshape',lb,'filled(right bg->1):',filled)
# demo2
inp2=G['Demo pair 2 input']; out2=G['Demo pair 2 output']
H2,W2=len(inp2),len(inp2[0]); bg=8; sc=6

    lb=max(sh)
    print('demo2 row',a,'lastshape',lb,'filled:',[(j,out2[a][j]) for j in range(lb+1,W2)])

steps.input:
import os,re,json,itertools
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def stats(inp,out):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); bg=max(set(x for r in inp for x in r), key=lambda c: sum(r.count(c) for r in inp))
    sc=[c for c in set(x for r in inp for x in r)-{bg}][0]
    chg=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]!=out[i][j]]
    res=[]
    for i,j in chg:
        # nearest shape cell in same row (left)
        left=[k for k in range(j) if inp[i][k]==sc]; nd_left=j-(left[-1] if left else -1)
        right=[k for k in range(j+1,W) if inp[i][k]==sc]; nd_right=(right[0]-j if right else W-j)
        up=[k for k in range(i) if inp[k][j]==sc]; down=[k for k in range(i+1,H) if inp[k][j]==sc]
        res.append(dict(row=i,col=j,chg=True,nd_l=nd_left,nd_r=nd_right,up_len=len(up),dn_len=len(down),
                       colparity=j%2,rowparity=i%2,dist_to_edge=W-1-j))
    # sample unpainted bg cells in same rows for comparison
    samp=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if inp[i][j]==bg and (i,j) not in set(chg):
                left=[k for k in range(j) if inp[i][k]==sc]; right=[k for k in range(j+1,W) if inp[i][k]==sc]
                up=[k for k in range(i) if inp[k][j]==sc]; down=[k for k in range(i+1,H) if inp[k][j]==sc]
                samp.append(dict(row=i,col=j,chg=False,nd_l=j-(left[-1] if left else -1),nd_r=(right[0]-j if right else W-j),
                                 up_len=len(up),dn_len=len(down),colparity=j%2,rowparity=i%2,dist_to_edge=W-1-j))
    import collections
    ct=collections.Counter((r_['nd_l'],r_['nd_r'],r_['up_len'],r_['dn_len'],r_['colparity'],r_['rowparity']) for r_ in res)
    cs=collections.Counter((r_['nd_l'],r_['nd_r'],r_['up_len'],r_['dn_len'],r_['colparity'],r_['rowparity']) for r_ in samp)
    return ct,cs
ct,cs=stats(G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print('PAINTED:',ct); print('UNPAINTED SAMPLE:',cs)
ct2,cs2=stats(G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output'])
print('P2 PAINTED:',ct2); print('P2 UNPAINTED SAMPLE:',cs2)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
ex=[]
for n in range(1,5):
    g=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r); bg_=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
ex=[]
for n in range(1,6):
    g=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r); bg_=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sc=max((c for c in cnt if c!=bg_),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    sh={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==sc}
    for i in range(H):
        # only trailing bg cells (to right of last shape cell in this row)
        lastcol=max([j for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==sc], default=-1)
        tr=[j for j in range(lastcol+1,W) if g[i][j]==bg_]
        pt=set(j for j in tr if go[i][j]==1)
        if not tr: continue
        for j in tr:
            pat=''.join(('S' if (i+di,j+dj) in sh else '.') for di in (-1,0,1) for dj in (-1,0,1) if (di,dj)!=(0,0))
            ex.append((pat,int(j in pt)))
d=defaultdict(set)
for p,y in ex: d[p].add(y)
amb=[k for k,v in d.items() if len(v)>1]
print('ambiguous patterns:',amb)
for p in amb: print(p, d[p])
# also count distribution
print(Counter(tuple(x) for x in [p for p,_ in ex]))

steps.input:
# Vertical slice around target col: rows i-1..i+1, cols j-1..j+1 -> 3x3 patterns.
for n in range(1,6):
    g=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r); bg_=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sc=max((c for c in cnt if c!=bg_),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    sh={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==sc}
    for i in range(H):
        lastcol=max([j for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==sc], default=-1)
        tr=[j for j in range(lastcol+1,W) if g[i][j]==bg_]
        pt=set(j for j in tr if go[i][j]==1)
        if not tr: continue
        for j in tr:
            pat=''.join(('S' if (ri,djc) in sh else '.') for ri in (i-1,i,i+1) for djc in (j-1,j,j+1) if 0<=ri<H and 0<=djc<W)
            print(n,i,j,'painted',j in pt,pat)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
cases=[]
for n in range(1,6):
    g=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r); bg_=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sc=max((c for c in cnt if c!=bg_),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    sh={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==sc}
    for i in range(H):
        lastcol=max([j for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==sc], default=-1)
        tr=[j for j in range(lastcol+1,W) if g[i][j]==bg_]
        pt=set(j for j in tr if go[i][j]==1)
        if not tr: continue
        for j in tr:
            # does any neighbor (incl diagonal) within object rows have shape? use nearest shape in same column below/above
            adj = any((i+di,j+dj) in sh for di in(-1,0,1) for dj in(-1,0,1))
            colshape = any(g[a][j]==sc for a in range(H))
            rowshape = g[i][j-1]==sc if j>0 else False
            cases.append(dict(pair=n,row=i,col=j,painted=j in pt,adj=adj,colshape=colshape,rowshape=rowshape,
                              gap_before=(j-1) in [k for k in range(W) if g[i][k]==bg_ and k<=lastcol] if False else None,
                              # distance to nearest shape cell horizontally向左
                              dist_left=min((lastcol-k) for k in range(j) if g[i][k]==sc) if any(g[i][k]==sc for k in range(j)) else 99,
                              dist_right=None,
                              obj_rows_sorted=sorted({a for a,b in sh if b==j}) if any(g[a][j]==sc for a in range(H)) else None,
                              ))
print(len(cases))
# test predicate: painted iff adj (8-neighbor shape)
amb=[c for c in cases if c['painted'] != c['adj']]
print('adj fails:',len(amb), amb[:5])
amb2=[c for c in cases if c['painted'] != (c['adj'] or c['colshape'])]
print('adj|colshape fails:',len(amb2), amb2[:5])

import itertools
# Build clean feature table for ALL trailing-bg cells across demos, labeled painted/unpainted.
rows_data=[]
for n in range(1,6):
    g=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; sc=max((c for c in cnt if c!=bg),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    S={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==sc}
    # group rows into objects: consecutive rows containing shape
    obj_rows=[]; cur=None
    for i in range(H):
        if any(g[i][j]==sc for j in range(W)):
            if cur is None: cur=[i]
            else: cur.append(i)
        else:
            if cur: obj_rows.append(cur); cur=None
    if cur: obj_rows.append(cur)
    for orow in obj_rows:
        o=set(orow)
        for i in orow:
            lastcol=max(j for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==sc)
            for j in range(lastcol+1,W):
                if g[i][j]!=bg: continue
                dmin=min(abs(i-a)+abs(j-b) for a,b in S)
                mind=min(abs(i-a)+abs(b-j) for a,b in S if b==j)
                mindr=min(abs(a-i)+abs(j-b) for a,b in S if a==i)
                near_shape = any(abs(i-a)<=1 and abs(j-b)<=1 for a,b in S)
                col_above = (i-1,j) in S if i>0 else False
                col_below = (i+1,j) in S if i<H-1 else False
                diag_up_l = (i-1,j-1) in S if i>0 else False
                diag_down_r = (i+1,j+1) in S if i<H-1 else False
                row_has_two_runs = len([1 for k in range(W) if g[i][k]==sc])>1
                is_top = min(o)==i
                is_bot = max(o)==i
                rows_data.append(dict(pair=n,row=i,col=j,painted=go[i][j]==1,
                                      dmin=dmin,mind=mind,mindr=mindr,near_shape=near_shape,
                                      col_above=col_above,col_below=col_below,
                                      duL=diag_up_l,ddR=diag_down_r,
                                      two_runs=row_has_two_runs,is_top=is_top,is_bot=is_bot,
                                      gap_after_last=W-lastcol-1))
print(len(rows_data))
P=[c for c in rows_data if c['painted']]
U=[c for c in rows_data if not c['painted']]
for f in ['near_shape','col_above','col_below','duL','ddR','is_top','is_bot','two_runs']:

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
